compartment: Trabecular portion of tibial secondary ossification center (IIOC)
status: Provisional image-traced endocortical and sub-plate boundary
grid: tibia-aligned U,V,W indices at 0.0105 mm isotropic
interpretation: Upper points trace transition under plate into trabecular compartment; lateral endpoints constrain inner shell. Include solid trabecular bridges and marrow, not individual pore masks. Intersect parent IIOC, exclude proximal growth-plate face by 2 voxels and outer surface by 2 voxels. Dense medial transition remains uncertain.
deviation_from_paper: User-requested strictly sub-plate, above-growth-plate trabecular IIOC ROI; narrower than paper wording including all noncortical solid and trabecular tissue through portions of the growth-plate region.
height_revision: User requires direct rulers after tibial orientation correction. Slice counting is retired from primary reporting and height/width ratio.
